target: x and y are stable manipulable trait dimensions
minimum_design: independent manipulation checks for x and y
positive_result: each coordinate changes as intended without materially moving the other
main_alternative: one intervention moves a composite phenotype rather than a distinct axis

target: x loads mainly on function 1 and y mainly on function 2
positive_result: abs(x_to_f1)>abs(x_to_f2) and abs(y_to_f2)>abs(y_to_f1) with compatible uncertainty
main_alternative: both traits are similarly pleiotropic or cross-loading is unresolved

target: adding y releases x toward the function-1-facing state optimum from SCH
minimum_design: multi-level x under low/high y with SCH z_P_star reference
positive_result: distance from x_star(y_high) to z_P_star is smaller than distance from x_star(y_low) to z_P_star
claim_ceiling: state-specific dimensional release of the focal trait; not pure-function release

target: adding y releases x toward independently identified pure z_F1_star
minimum_design: multi-level x under low/high y plus SCH independent pure-function optimum receipt
positive_result: distance from x_star(y_high) to z_F1_star is smaller than distance from x_star(y_low) to z_F1_star
main_alternative: state-specific release exists but pure function optimum is unavailable or not approached
claim_ceiling: pure-function dimensional release only when stronger SCH input exists

target: two-dimensional architecture improves attainable common fitness
minimum_design: shared-state comparator plus x-y surface and architecture-cost accounting
positive_result: W_diff_star exceeds W_shared_star after declared added costs
main_alternative: extra cost K or residual coupling erases mismatch benefit
claim_ceiling: functional release beyond shared compromise; Delta_mod only on commensurable scales

target: release is generated by the intended functional channels
minimum_design: x x y x function-1 access x function-2 access crossed intervention plus independent cost assay
positive_result: selective channel contrasts allocate relief/interference and remaining cost with compatible uncertainty
main_alternative: same total surface produced by alternative allocations

target: putatively differentiated traits remain partly coupled or become approximately separable
positive_result: near-zero four-way coupling supports simple separability; non-zero coupling quantifies partial modularity
main_alternative: assuming complete modularity from two traits alone

target: ancestral shared architecture evolved into differentiated descendants
minimum_design: phylogenetic/developmental/genetic transition evidence plus functional states
positive_result: reconstructed shared-to-differentiated transitions with alternative-history tests
main_alternative: extant x+y arose independently or ancestral state unresolved
